# Beisen public source fixtures

These are public campus list and detail responses from the official tenant sites. The consumer research ledger and `manifest.json` record the full official authorization chains, original response hashes, fixture hashes and two complete production-reader checks. No applicant account, login, application submission or database write was used.

- MINISO: `https://miniso.cn/` links “招聘” to `https://miniso.zhiye.com/`. The verified public tenant is `109979`. The complete category `2` snapshot contains 28 records in two pages, of 20 and 8. Both AI technical details have matching UUID, numeric job ID, title, category, open status and duty/requirement content.
- Mixue: `https://www.mxbc.com/about.html` links “投递简历” to `https://careers.mxbc.com/`. The verified public tenant is `111025`. The complete category `2` snapshot contains 26 records in two pages, of 20 and 6. System implementation and data development are in scope. Security job `60148cbe-d12c-407d-b7d3-2cec5e41caa1` says 2027 in the title and 2026 in its requirements; retain that original response as a rejected conflict rather than changing either year.

The normal page's observed list request is `POST /api/Jobad/GetJobAdPageList` with a zero-based `PageIndex`, `PageSize: 20`, `Category: ["2"]`, an empty keyword and portal ID, and the actual displayed list fields. The independent public detail request is `GET /api/JobAd/GetJobAdInfo` with `jobAdId`, `category: 2` and a JSON `displayFields` array. Degree and employment experience fields are requested explicitly, including fields the visual template chooses not to display.

Fixtures remove anonymous applicant state, recommendation reward configuration and unrelated ATS control flags. They keep the original public identity, category, status, descriptions, education and experience requirements, and location fields. Source publication and modification timestamps do not establish a deadline, and displayed cohort years do not establish a graduation date window.

The final focused suite passed in 18.448 seconds. Review counterexamples distinguish project years from employment years, retain a minimum of zero for a zero-to-one-year range, keep bonus sections and their majors optional, and expose an explicit one-year employment floor to the existing matcher. The real four documents were recomputed after those fixes and still match the unchanged production-reader hashes from both real rounds. `manifest.json` records the frozen implementation hashes and exact test log paths. Full PostgreSQL, Linux race and runtime acceptance are coordinated by the parent task.
